test_title: PYST 35: SSC CHSL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT with respect to High Yielding Varieties (HYVs)?

options.text: HYVs led to decrease in the cropping intensity.
HYVs had a shorter period of maturity.
They made green revolution technology as land-saving technology.
The usage of HYVs was complemented with the attraction of more investment in farm machines.

solution:
The correct answer is __**HYVs led to decrease in the cropping intensity**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 1** is incorrect as High Yielding Varieties (HYVs) led to an increase, not a decrease, in cropping intensity due to their shorter maturity period and higher productivity.
 
• **Option 2** is correct because HYVs indeed had a shorter period of maturity, allowing for multiple cropping cycles in a year.
 
• **Option 3** is correct as HYVs made green revolution technology a land-saving technology by increasing yield per hectare.
 
• **Option 4** is correct because the usage of HYVs was complemented with the attraction of more investment in farm machines, irrigation, and other inputs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The introduction of HYVs was a major component of the Green Revolution in India during the 1960s and 70s.
 
• HYVs required higher inputs of fertilizers, pesticides, and water, which led to an increase in agricultural productivity and self-sufficiency in food grains.
 
• The Green Revolution had significant socio-economic impacts, including changes in agricultural practices, rural incomes, and labor dynamics.
 
• Despite the benefits, the Green Revolution also brought about challenges such as environmental degradation, inequity among farmers, and over-reliance on chemical inputs.
